note: Canonical IronPulse exercise catalogue. Instructions are original text. media_url must only reference media IronPulse is licensed to use; none are bundled yet.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width, pull shoulder blades back and down.
Unrack, lower the bar under control to the mid-chest.
Press up and slightly back until arms are straight.
safety: Use a spotter or safety arms when training near failure.
Keep wrists stacked over elbows; do not bounce the bar off the chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to roughly 30 degrees.
Start with dumbbells at chest level, palms facing forward or slightly inward.
Press up until arms are nearly straight, then lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.
safety: Bring the dumbbells to your chest before lying back, and lower them to the chest before sitting up.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles line up with mid-chest.
Press forward until arms are extended without locking hard.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
safety: Keep your back against the pad throughout.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set pulleys around shoulder height and step forward into a split stance.
With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in a wide arc.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
safety: Keep the elbow angle fixed; avoid over-stretching the shoulders.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Bring the handles together in front of you, squeezing the chest.
Return under control.
safety: Set the start position so the shoulders are not forced past a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower until the chest is close to the floor.
Push back up while keeping hips in line.
safety: Elevate the hands on a bench to make the movement easier if needed.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit upright with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead until arms are nearly straight.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.
safety: Avoid arching the lower back; brace the core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the arms out to the sides to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
safety: Use a weight you can control without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set the pulley low and stand side-on to the machine.
Raise the handle out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
safety: Keep the torso still; avoid leaning away to cheat the weight up.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing the pad with handles at shoulder height.
Sweep the arms back in an arc, leading with the elbows.
Return under control.
safety: Do not shrug; keep shoulders down.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Use a rope at upper-chest height.
Pull toward your face, separating the rope ends as you go.
Return slowly.
safety: Choose a light weight and focus on control.

exercises.name: Cable Pushdown
instructions: Hold a bar or rope at a high pulley, elbows at your sides.
Extend the elbows until arms are straight.
Let the handle rise slowly without moving the elbows forward.
safety: Keep the elbows pinned; avoid using body weight to push.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Extension
instructions: Face away from a pulley holding a rope behind your head.
Extend the arms forward and up.
Return slowly to a deep stretch.
safety: Use a staggered stance for balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower it behind the head by bending the elbows.
Extend back to the start.
safety: Keep the elbows pointing forward and the core braced.

exercises.name: Assisted Dips
instructions: Select assistance on the machine and grip the bars.
Lower until elbows are around 90 degrees.
Press back up.
safety: Stop the descent if you feel discomfort at the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders, thighs under the pads.
Pull the bar to the upper chest, driving elbows down.
Return slowly to full arm extension.
safety: Avoid pulling behind the neck.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull until your chin passes the bar.
Lower to a full hang under control.
safety: Use an assisted machine or band until full reps are possible.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet on the platform and a slight knee bend.
Row the handle to your lower ribs.
Extend the arms slowly while keeping the chest up.
safety: Do not round the lower back to reach forward.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench.
Row the dumbbells toward your hips.
Lower until arms are straight.
safety: Keep the chest on the pad throughout.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench, back flat.
Row the dumbbell toward the hip.
Lower to a full stretch; complete reps then switch sides.
safety: Keep the spine neutral; avoid twisting the torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl up without moving the elbows forward.
Lower slowly.
safety: Avoid swinging the torso.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl

Curl up keeping the neutral grip.
Lower under control.
safety: Keep wrists neutral.

exercises.name: Cable Curl

Curl the bar toward the shoulders.
Lower slowly to full extension.
safety: Keep elbows close to the body.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest the upper arms on the preacher pad.
Curl up until forearms are near vertical.
Lower slowly without fully relaxing at the bottom.
safety: Do not drop into the bottom position; the elbow is vulnerable when fully extended under load.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on the upper back, feet about shoulder width.
Brace and sit down between the hips to a depth you can control.
Drive up through the whole foot.
safety: Use safety pins in a rack.
Keep knees tracking over the toes.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest.
Squat down keeping the chest tall.
Stand back up.
safety: Choose a depth that keeps your back neutral.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Place feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the sled until knees are around 90 degrees.
Press back up without locking the knees.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Align knees with the machine pivot.
Extend the legs until straight.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar at hip height with soft knees.
Push the hips back, sliding the bar down the thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward.
safety: Keep the back neutral; range of motion ends where your back would start to round.

Curl the heels toward the glutes.
Return slowly.
safety: Keep hips pressed into the pad.

Hold a straight line from head to heels.

Return slowly.
